author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Ireland’s Eddie Dunbar overtook Santiago Buitrago in the final 500 meters to win Stage 19 of the Vuelta a España on Friday, timing his chase at the end of a hilly day into Estepona.
Dunbar, riding for Pinarello Q36.5, reeled in the Colombian climber after Buitrago had moved into the lead. Teammate Thomas Gloag finished third on the 210.8-kilometer route from Vélez-Málaga.

Spanish rider Enric Mas retained the overall leader’s jersey and will start Saturday’s penultimate stage with an advantage of one minute, 37 seconds over Primoz Roglic. The next test is a 186.8-kilometer mountain route from La Calahorra to Collado del Alguacil.

Dunbar’s late acceleration settled the stage without changing the top of the general classification. Mas now has one major mountain day left before the race reaches its final conclusion, while Roglic must erase a substantial deficit if he is to take the overall lead.
dek: The Irish rider caught Santiago Buitrago with 500 meters remaining while Enric Mas protected the overall lead.
headline: Eddie Dunbar wins Vuelta Stage 19 with late pass
